title: Nyack childhood and the neighbors' bells
summary: Not a musical family; the boy is fascinated by a neighboring family's set of bells near Nyack.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you have a musical family?

Early on though I do remember there was a family, a very famous painter who had a farm up on Congers, Andrew Davies, and the kids used to walk to Nyack from their farm. They still have a very good farm.
They were possessors of a set of bells and they used to ring them, and it fascinated me and I can remember sitting alongside the road, 9W, and it was not a national highway at the time--
I'd ring those bells with these kids. I couldn't have been more than four or five years old.
